inputs.text: What's unfolding in Nigeria lays bare how the wealthy elite have seized control of democracy to shut out working people and everyone else. The ruling APC's moves ahead of the 2027 elections are turning political parties into closed-off clubs that silence the poor and marginalized communities, stripping them of any real say. This is no coincidence or minor issue—it's the predictable result of deep, long-standing structural inequalities that hoard power for a tiny group of the rich and powerful while the rest of society bears the harm. We need to expose this directly and fight for urgent reforms that center labor rights, dismantle these barriers, and defend vulnerable groups instead of letting the elite keep rigging the system for their own gain.
